newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia central bank shrugs off band speculation.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia central bank shrugs off band speculation.

text.p: Indonesia central bank governor Sudradjad Djiwandono on Wednesday shrugged off market speculation of another widening in the dollar-rupiah intervention band.
"Our monetary policy is eclectic and pragmatic. We keep adjusting whenever it is necessary. But I can't say when it's necessary," he said.
"Our policy is flexible. I can't take the mystery out from the market," Djiwandono brief reporters ahead of the annual bankers' dinner in Jakarta on Wednesday.
Speculation has been rife in the foreign exchange market that the band would be widened following strong capital inflows from offshore investors due to the attractive rates offered by the rupiah.
The central bank last widened its intervention band in September to eight percent from five percent.
The band allows the central bank to intervene into the market if the rates fall out from the band.
